jaggeryGeometry.explanation: Heading and value columns have different row pitches. Their centres are not equal, but projected half-height overlap yields unique PACKED/date and USEBY/date pairs. MRP/price does not meet the row band. No ordinal matching between column rows is used.

interpretation: Same current parser and exact8photos: raw1/10 valid exact critical fields, full derived ordering2/10. The only additional eligible field is Jaggery PACKED ON:02/08/2026. Exactly1review-only declaration proposal survives filtering. General full-row transcript is not safe for automatic adoption because unrelated same-y columns also get joined.
parserInteraction: Parent dotted-PKD-BY punctuation fix is present in both arms. Raw remains1/10 with that parser; adding geometry produces2/10. Removing the spurious PKD.by conflict is a prerequisite for the reconstructed date to count, not an OCR character-recognition gain.
deploymentRecommendation: Do not silently replace raw OCR with the full derived transcript. At most expose strict mapped reviewableDeclarationProposals for explicit officer acceptance, preserving raw evidence and logging the decision.
limitations: AI visual labels are provisional and require independent human review; this is reused development data, not holdout.
Geometry policy was developed after inspecting development-image box geometry and synthetic safety cases, not measured on an independent evaluation set.
Numeric values, headings, units, spelling and punctuation are not repaired. Only row order and spaces change.
Original strings and boxes are retained in the hash-linked input; reconstructed-row parts repeat exact source mappings.
Broad row joins include unrelated columns, such as AFTER USE plus1l; proposed declaration filter excludes these but has no independent field-validation proof.
No officer has accepted the proposal during this benchmark; suggestions are not verified facts or automatic compliance decisions.
No legal verdict metric, probabilistic confidence calibration, representative field accuracy or production-live claim is made.
